card.name: The word serum before lab tests
card.fires_on: The word serum (or the end of it, ser|um) when it starts a lab measurement phrase such as serum creatinine or serum drug levels. It also fires weakly on blood in a similar lab-sample setting.

modes.label: Serum starting a lab value
modes.description: Serum at the start of a sentence or heading, followed by an analyte such as creatinine, phosphorus or a drug level.
modes.example: upon resolution:<< Serum>> creatinine 2 mg/dL or

modes.label: Serum in running text
modes.description: Lowercase serum, or the final piece of it, inside a sentence about checking a blood level.
modes.example: ic checking of<< serum>> electrolyte levels is advisable during prolonged therapy
